Logo detection benchmark

34 vision models, 39 human-labeled social media frames, 5 brands, 5 resolution rungs (1080p to 144p). One canonical prompt, boxes scored against human truth at IoU thresholds. Hover any mark for details; chips filter models everywhere.

Research by Leon Hartmann
generated 2026-08-11 · 6,800 API calls · $95.51 total

Findings

Written 2026-08-11 after the full 34-row matrix (24 base models, 5 reference-image conditions, 5 zoom-tool conditions; about 9,000 calls, $75). Edit results/findings.html to update this section.

questionanswer
Best at finding brandsclaude-opus-5 and gemini-3.6-flash+zoom, both presence F1 0.799; the zoom variant costs a third of opus
Best at drawing boxesqwen3-vl-plus by a huge margin: hit@0.3 0.603, mean IoU 0.886, at $0.80 per 1,000 frames. The frontier generalists know a brand is there but cannot localize it (opus 0.143, gemini 0.143, sonnet 0.008)
Best valueseed-2.0-mini: F1 0.760 at $1.01 per 1,000 frames; with the zoom tool 0.789 at $1.20, which is opus-level presence at 1/30th of the price
Most resolution-proofThe Gemini family (93 percent F1 retention at 144p) and gpt-5.6 sol/terra (90-93 percent). The box specialist qwen3-vl-plus collapses at low res (58 percent retention): specialists need pixels
Recommended pipelineCheap cascade: seed-2.0-mini(+zoom) for presence, qwen3-vl-plus for boxes; about $2 per 1,000 frames total

Reference images: dose and placement matter, not a free win. On the four brands with real sample sizes, attaching five per-brand reference collages to every call helped the small models (muse-glimmer +0.045, seed-2.0-mini +0.019 presence F1), did nothing for the frontier models (within noise), and hurt the VL specialist (qwen3-vl-plus -0.061, stripes recall 1.00 to 0.69). The one unambiguous effect: box quality halves for the box-strong models with refs in context (seed hit@0.3 0.485 to 0.257, qwen3-vl-plus 0.603 to 0.266, over all 242 truth boxes). Keep reference images away from whatever draws boxes. The apparent 11teamsports collapse under refs is not interpretable: that brand has exactly one truth frame, and the refs made models stop guessing (baseline precision was 0.17-0.25, mostly false positives). More 11teamsports truth frames are needed before any conclusion about the benchmark's weakest brand.

Zoom tool: modest, real, and rational. Letting models request up to three 2x crops of the same rung image lifted gemini-3.6-flash by +0.036 (into a tie for first), seed-2.0-mini by +0.029, and doubled opus's box hit rate (0.143 to 0.274, at 3x its cost). Models zoom more the lower the resolution (gpt-5.6-terra: 1.1 zooms per frame at 1080p, 2.2 at 144p); the specialist barely zooms at all. Zoom crops come from the same rung, upscaled, so these gains are attention gains, not smuggled pixels.

Format compliance is part of capability. perceptron-mk1 (75 percent parse failure) and ui-tars-1.5-7b (own output dialect, F1 0.0) cannot be used through a JSON contract regardless of their vision quality. kimi-k3 and gpt-5.6-sol needed a 16k-token completion budget before their reasoning stopped truncating mid-answer; with it, both parse cleanly.

Caveats: OpenAI gpt-5.6 and Anthropic Claude 5 endpoints reject an explicit temperature, so those rows ran at API default while all others ran at temperature 0. 11teamsports has n=1 truth frames; treat its column as an anecdote. One of the 40 dataset frames has no completed truth label and scores as empty. Truth was pre-labeled by qwen3-vl-plus and human-reviewed box by box (provenance recorded per label file), which may slightly flatter that model's IoU scores.

allnone

Logo detection only ranks by presence F1: did the model report the brand at all. Detection + boxes ranks by hit@0.3: the share of truth logos the model found AND boxed at IoU 0.3 or better.

Method comparison: plain vs reference images vs zoom tool

Finding brands: presence F1 at the top rung

Same model, three ways of asking. Missing bars mean the condition was not run for that model.

basewith refswith zoom

Drawing boxes: hit@0.3 at the top rung

Share of truth boxes matched at IoU 0.3 or better. Reference images visibly cost the box-strong models their localization.

basewith refswith zoom

Low resolution: presence F1 at 144p

The zoom tool is allowed to enlarge crops of the same 144p image; gains here are attention, not extra pixels.

basewith refswith zoom

Hallucination check: precision vs recall

Macro presence precision against recall at the top rung. Below the diagonal means the model reports brands that are not there; right of it means it finds what exists. Only models with F1 above 0.05 shown.

Speed: median seconds per call

Median latency at the top rung, log scale. Reasoning models think long; specialists answer fast.

Finding brands vs drawing boxes

Presence F1 against mean IoU of matched boxes. Top right is the goal; the bottom right models know a brand is present but cannot localize it.

Per-brand presence F1 (top rung)

Darker is worse, lighter is better. Columns are ordered by how many truth frames contain the brand; treat low-n columns as anecdotes.
